basis: The supplied v4 workbook Vehicle_Coverage and All_Datasets sheets, with selected public primary documentation checked on October 12, 2026. No payloads were downloaded and no vehicle operating mode was independently verified.

vehicles.name: Waymo research and robotaxi fleet
vehicles.associationNote: These are official Waymo datasets. The exact collection vehicle and sensor generation must be checked in each release; the illustrated I-PACE does not identify every recording vehicle.

datasets.summary: Camera and LiDAR perception data for studying road scenes, objects and sensor fusion.
datasets.limitations: Road and object labels do not establish crack, pothole or measured pavement-severity ground truth.
datasets.name: Waymo Open Dataset - Perception
datasets.labels: No crack/pothole/roughness/wetness labels documented. Road/lane semantic classes and mapped speed bumps available
datasets.terms: Waymo Dataset License; noncommercial research restrictions; not the code's Apache license

datasets.summary: Camera sequences for end-to-end driving research and trajectory prediction.
datasets.limitations: A driving benchmark is not a pavement-distress benchmark. Check release terms, target definitions and supported subsets.
datasets.name: Waymo Open Dataset - End-to-End Driving
datasets.labels: No pavement distress labels; construction/debris scenario clusters are related context
datasets.terms: Waymo Dataset License; noncommercial research restrictions

datasets.relationship: Relevant road-condition alternative; independent of Waymo
datasets.summary: ZOD adds road-condition annotations and camera–LiDAR pairs for condition-aware perception research.
datasets.limitations: Zenseact collection, not Waymo footage. Road-condition metadata must not be treated as calibrated distress severity.
datasets.name: Zenseact Open Dataset (ZOD: Frames, Sequences, Drives)
datasets.labels: Binary wetness and snow_coverage labels for Frames; ego-road and debris masks; no cracks/potholes/PCI

vehicles.name: Tesla Cybercab concept
vehicles.associationNote: No qualifying public Cybercab research release is identified in the supplied inventory. The links below are third-party Tesla-owner recordings from NATIX, not Cybercab data or a Tesla Inc. dataset.

datasets.summary: A small multi-camera event collection includes VLM descriptions of road-surface deterioration.
datasets.limitations: Manually validate event descriptions. The card states gated access and NATIX Data RAIL-NC terms; automated-driving engagement is not established.
datasets.name: NATIX Edge Case Driving Dataset
datasets.labels: Road surface deterioration among event categories; VLM-generated descriptions, not engineered distress/severity ground truth
datasets.terms: NATIX Data RAIL-NC; noncommercial; no redistribution; limited term

datasets.summary: Multi-camera driving sequences with GNSS and trip metadata for camera-based perception studies.
datasets.limitations: Crowdsourced owner recordings with no established Cybercab connection or engineered pavement distress targets.
datasets.name: NATIX Multi-Camera Driving Dataset
datasets.labels: None documented; weather and OSM road-type metadata are not pavement condition
datasets.terms: NATIX Data RAIL-NC; noncommercial; no redistribution; limited term

datasets.summary: Safety-critical driving events for investigating difficult road-scene interactions.
datasets.limitations: Event targets serve driving research; they do not supply a validated pavement distress taxonomy.
datasets.name: NATIX Safety Critical Driving Events Dataset
datasets.labels: None documented; harsh braking/acceleration/turning are vehicle behavior events
datasets.terms: NATIX Data RAIL-NC; noncommercial; no redistribution; limited term

vehicles.name: Aurora autonomous truck
vehicles.associationNote: The supplied search found no qualifying Aurora truck-camera release. Pit30M has an Aurora connection through historical Uber ATG collection; it must not be presented as Aurora truck footage. MAN and Torc are independent trucking alternatives.

datasets.relationship: Aurora-linked historical research collection; not truck footage
datasets.summary: Pit30M / Aurora Multi-Sensor data supports visual localization and multimodal mapping.
datasets.limitations: Historical Uber ATG vehicle collection. No documented pavement distress/severity labels and no claim that the illustrated Aurora truck collected it.
datasets.name: Aurora Multi-Sensor Dataset / Pit30M
datasets.labels: Weather metadata and semantic segmentation; no pavement distress/severity annotations documented
datasets.terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; intended for noncommercial academic use

datasets.summary: TruckScenes provides a truck-specific multimodal perception reference.
datasets.limitations: MAN development-truck recordings, not Aurora data. Weather and object annotations do not establish distress labels.
datasets.name: MAN TruckScenes
datasets.labels: 34 scene tags include weather/lighting/area; no pavement distress or severity labels documented

datasets.relationship: Independent truck dataset from Torc Robotics
datasets.summary: TruckDrive targets long-range highway perception from an autonomous trucking program.
datasets.limitations: Resolve the current release scope before reuse: the project describes multimodal sensing, while the linked license says raw sensor streams are not part of the licensed material. Access was not tested.
datasets.name: TruckDrive
datasets.labels: No pavement-condition labels documented; object/scene annotations and depth supervision
datasets.terms: Torc custom noncommercial/commercial license files; check applicable terms

vehicles.name: Rivian electric delivery vehicle
vehicles.associationNote: No public Rivian EDV footage dataset is identified by the supplied search dated October 11, 2026. These independent datasets support related urban perception studies; none is claimed to have been collected by a Rivian EDV.

datasets.summary: nuScenes offers multimodal urban road scenes for object perception and sensor fusion.
datasets.limitations: No Rivian affiliation is asserted. The capture platform, sensor arrangement and pavement targets differ from a delivery vehicle deployment.
datasets.name: nuScenes
datasets.labels: No pavement distress or surface-state labels documented; object boxes and road/drivable-area semantics
datasets.terms: Noncommercial dataset terms; commercial licensing by request

datasets.summary: Audi A2D2 includes camera imagery, point clouds, segmentation and automotive-bus data.
datasets.limitations: Audi collection, not EDV footage. Examine license and target definitions for the intended study.
datasets.name: A2D2 (Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset)
datasets.labels: No pavement distress/surface-state labels documented; road and other semantic classes

datasets.summary: ZOD provides camera–LiDAR data with road-condition annotations across varied European settings.
datasets.limitations: Zenseact collection, not Rivian data. The dataset's road conditions are not measured pavement severity.
datasets.name: Zenseact Open Dataset (ZOD: Frames, Sequences, Drives)
datasets.labels: Binary wetness and snow_coverage labels for Frames; ego-road and debris masks; no cracks/potholes/PCI

vehicles.name: Instrumented laboratory survey vehicle
vehicles.associationNote: The vehicle is a generic educational research rig. These independently collected datasets illustrate camera, inertial and positioning workflows; no dataset was produced by the illustrated rig.

datasets.summary: PVS pairs vehicular camera, GPS and inertial measurements for road-surface and roughness research.
datasets.limitations: Roughness categories are not calibrated IRI. Vehicle and driver factors are paired; inspect the study design before generalizing.
datasets.name: PVS - Passive Vehicular Sensors Datasets
datasets.labels: Good/regular/bad roughness by vehicle side; asphalt/cobblestone/dirt; paved/unpaved; speed-bump classes.

datasets.summary: Oxford RobotCar provides repeated route observations for studying mapping under seasonal and traffic changes.
datasets.limitations: An autonomy and localization resource, without a documented pavement distress/severity annotation layer in this inventory.
datasets.name: Oxford RobotCar / Radar RobotCar
datasets.labels: No pavement distress/surface-state labels documented; repeated seasons, weather and roadworks
datasets.terms: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 plus access terms; academic noncommercial robotics research

datasets.summary: KITTI Raw connects driving imagery with synchronized sensing for perception and mapping.
datasets.limitations: Use the raw-data and calibration documentation. Public object benchmarks do not establish road-distress labels. The official page could not be freshly fetched during this website update.
datasets.name: KITTI Raw (with KITTI benchmark family)
datasets.labels: No pavement distress/surface-state labels documented; raw object tracklets and separate road benchmark masks

vehicles.name: Passenger car with driver assistance
vehicles.associationNote: These datasets are relevant to passenger-car perception and driver-assistance research. The illustration is generic, and dataset inclusion does not establish that assistance was active during every recorded segment.

datasets.summary: comma2k19 combines road-facing video, GNSS, inertial and CAN signals from commuter driving.
datasets.limitations: The inventory assigns the Unlabeled-13 documentation profile for unlabeled use. Pose estimates are available, but pavement-distress targets are not documented.
datasets.name: comma2k19
datasets.terms: Repository MIT; review downloaded data notices

datasets.summary: Audi A2D2 combines camera and LiDAR data with semantic annotations and automotive-bus information.
datasets.limitations: Collection for AV research does not prove autonomous operation in each recording. Review image/label pairing and terms.
datasets.name: A2D2 (Audi Autonomous Driving Dataset)
datasets.labels: No pavement distress/surface-state labels documented; road and other semantic classes

datasets.summary: ZOD supplies road-condition, object and lane annotations for varied driving conditions.
datasets.limitations: Road condition includes a different target space from pavement engineering distress or severity. Declare the intended task before comparing.
datasets.name: Zenseact Open Dataset (ZOD: Frames, Sequences, Drives)
datasets.labels: Binary wetness and snow_coverage labels for Frames; ego-road and debris masks; no cracks/potholes/PCI
